name: mehir
bio: Developer working with systems and open-source tooling. Writing software in C and Python, currently exploring Rust and Ruby.
subBio: Daily driver is Omarchy (Arch Linux). Contributor to community software ecosystems and search infrastructure. Always open to jump into meaningful open-source projects.

projects.name: Omanet
projects.desc: Native Omarchy plugin for controlling Android USB reverse tethering through GNirehtet, featuring top-bar controls and systemd service integration.

projects.name: Omarchy-Tide-Island
projects.desc: Tide Island integration for Omarchy with native theme and wallpaper picking, configurable shortcuts, and desktop OSD / notification integration.

projects.name: Local_Chess
projects.desc: Play chess with friends nearby with no internet required. Connect over Bluetooth or local Wi-Fi for real-time peer-to-peer multiplayer chess matches.

contributions.name: Omarchy Plugin Marketplace
contributions.desc: Contributed to the plugin marketplace ecosystem for Omarchy users. Worked on repository indexing, package validation rules, and streamlined installation tooling for customized Arch environments.

contributions.name: Xerj AI Search Engine
contributions.desc: Contributed to query ingestion and indexing routines for the Xerj search engine. Assisted in processing pipeline handlers and performance improvements for data fetching.
